title: QA run · smoke:npm-18.6.0 (23/23) · 958ee035 · 2026-11-18 · 21 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 2 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

The post-release npm smoke of the published 18.6.0 (checklist-test §6, #34632 D2-A signal ①). The maintainer said, verbatim: 「18.6 已经发布了」. The shape is copied from #33900. Filed by the seat from runner `session_01QSeKYkqMoHzmQFEoB3xZqK`'s report (Sonnet, effort high, nominal $4.09); the runner made no GitHub write.

## ENVIRONMENT
- **Subject:** `@objectstack/*@18.6.0` and `create-objectstack@18.6.0` from npm. Published 2026-11-18T05:50:28Z (`npm view @objectstack/spec time`). The 18.5.0 version was 2026-11-15T13:02Z.
- **Dist-tags:** `latest` = 18.6.0, `next` = 18.5.0. See O-F1.
- **Release commit:** `958ee03594968c651db1bc40ecb05bfe72f94b2d` ("chore: version packages (#33849)", 2026-11-18T04:44Z), tag `@objectstack/spec@18.6.0`.
- **Previous release commit:** `b914e724`, an ancestor of `958ee035`. 547 commits lie between them.
- **Install:** everything under test came from the registry into the scratchpad `s1/` and `s2/` directories, outside the repo. There was no workspace build and no `link:`.
- **Docs:** the checkout was used only to read docs and history with `git show 958ee035:PATH`.
- **Main:** read at `55020c331b` (2026-11-18T09:11Z).
- **Tools:** Node v22.23.5, npm 10.9.9, pnpm 10.28.0 in the scaffolds, PostgreSQL 16.15 (a local cluster on port 41119), Chromium through Playwright.
- **Ports:** 41100–41105 and 41119–41123, one file DB per cell. All were free at the end and the pg cluster was stopped.
- **Runners:** the run was 09:30–~09:50Z. S1 (me) ran A, B, C, E and F. One helper subagent, S2, ran D in parallel and did not touch the repo or GitHub.
- **pg data dir:** `postgres` cannot read root-only scratchpad paths, so the cluster data dir was `/tmp/smoke186pg` (a deviation from the scratchpad rule).

## A. NEW USER ONBOARDING (docs at 958ee035: `getting-started/your-first-project.mdx`)
- **A1 PASS.** `npm create objectstack@18.6.0 my-app -- --skip-skills` exited 0 in 11 s with the banner "Create ObjectStack v18.6.0".
  - It installed with pnpm and wrote no `.claude` dir.
  - All 9 `@objectstack` pins in `package.json` are exactly 18.6.0.
  - cli, spec and runtime resolve 18.6.0, and the console resolves as `@objectstack+console@18.6.0`.
  - The lock holds 59 `@objectstack/*@18.6.0` package entries (the 18.5.0 record counted 60 entries by a differently scoped grep) and no other version.
- **A2 PASS.** `npx -y create-objectstack@18.6.0 skillapp` (skills on): "Installing AI skills … from @objectstack/skills@18.6.0", "Found 12 skills".
  - `.claude/skills` holds 12 skills, and `skills-lock.json` is written.
  - `diff -rq` against `node_modules/@objectstack/skills/dist/skills` differs only by the catalog `README.md`.
  - Automation self-check: my first attempt piped the scaffolder into `head`, which killed it with SIGPIPE before the skills step. The rerun was clean.
- **A3 PASS.** `npx os validate` exit 0, "Running author-time rules (71)" (68 on 18.5.0), "Validation passed (139ms)".
  - It reports 1 object, 2 fields, 1 app, 1 view and 3 plugins.
- **A4 PASS.** `npx os dev --ui -p 41100` answered discovery in 10 s with "Server is ready".
  - Driver is `SqlDriver(better-sqlite3)` on `.objectstack/data/objectstack.db`, with the dev admin seeded.
  - 0 WARN/ERROR/DATABASE_ERROR lines in the 67-line boot log.
- **A5 PASS.** `GET /_console/` returns 200 text/html, 24195 bytes.
  - Entry chunk `assets/index-6xZL3GML.js` returns 200 application/javascript, 449078 bytes. It is `cmp`-identical to the published `@objectstack/console@18.6.0` dist (`npm pack`).
  - The 18.5.0 entry chunk was 391760 bytes (see O7).
- **A6 PASS.** Real browser, a fresh context: `/_console/` goes to `/_console/login` in 1.3 s, and the form sign-in as the dev admin lands on `/_console/home`.
  - Home shows "Get your system ready … 1 of 6 done".
  - After sign-in: 0 console errors and 0 responses ≥ 400.
  - Before sign-in: only the anonymous `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` answers 401 (same as 18.5.0, O1).
- **A7 PASS.** The docs' CRUD on :41100:
  - Sign-in 200, `POST /api/v1/data/my_app_note` 201, list `?select=title&sort=-created_at&top=10` 200 (total 1), GET 200, PATCH 200.
  - DELETE 200 with `recycleBinEntryId`, then GET 404.
  - Anonymous GET 401.
  - `POST /auth/sign-up/email` 403 `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`.
- **A8 PASS.** A record made through the Console UI.
  - At `/_console/apps/com.example.my-app/my_app_note`, New opens "Create Note", and Create gives `POST /api/v1/data/my_app_note` 201.
  - The record panel opens (`?recordId=R2BtWrZs6vzWWR_o`), and the server read-back returns 200 with the title "Created in Console UI 18.6".
  - 0 console errors and 0 responses ≥ 400 after sign-in.

## B. STUDIO (same dev boot)
- **B1 PASS.** `/_console/studio` loads the App Builder in 1.4 s with 0 console errors and 0 responses ≥ 400.
  - It shows "INSTALLED APPS … My App · No changes yet · Customize", "YOUR OWN APPS · New app of your own", and "Positions and permissions".
  - The wording is new since 18.5.0 (O3).
- **B2 PASS.** The authoring loop in a real browser:
  1. New app of your own opens the New Package dialog. Only Display name "Smoke Tracker" was filled, and `POST /api/v1/packages` returned 201.
  2. It lands on `/_console/studio/com.default.smoke-tracker/data` with "No drafts pending publish".
  3. New object "Ticket" (identifier `ticket`, "Who can see which records: Only the owner can see") with Save as draft landed on `?surface=object:smoke_tracker_ticket`, "Draft · 1 unpublished", "Changes · 1".
  4. Publish opened "Pending changes · 1 item · 1 object (Ticket, New, Includes + Name)".
  5. Publish all gave the toast "Published 1 item in this package / Members can use it once a permission set grants them access / Open Access".
  6. After reload: "No drafts pending publish" and the live Records grid.
  - REST on the new object as the dev admin: `POST /data/smoke_tracker_ticket` 201 twice, list 200 total 2, anonymous 401, `/meta/_drafts` 200 `{"drafts":[]}`.
  - 0 console errors and 0 responses ≥ 400. (The write-call trace for this loop was only captured on the pg run, E2.)

## C. PRODUCTION PATH (A1's scaffold, `OS_AUTH_SECRET` and `OS_SECRET_KEY` set, fresh file DB `cdb/prod.db`)
- **C1 PASS.** `os build` exit 0 (`dist/objectstack.json` 3298 B).
  - `os migrate apply --yes` on the fresh DB exit 0: 94 tables created, 0 changes, 2 runtime-owned partial unique indexes, and "birth marker written (shape generation 1, platform 18.6.0)".
  - `os start --artifact ./dist/objectstack.json --port 41101`: Mode production, health in 8 s.
  - `GET /api/v1/health` returns 200 `{"status":"ok","version":"18.6.0"}`.
  - 0 WARN/ERROR lines at start, apart from the 2 "User not found" WARNs my own failed-sign-in probes caused. The start also prints the usual "StorageServicePlugin using local driver" advisory (O2).
- **C2 PASS.** The first sign-up is admitted (200, session token) and the second gets 403 `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`; that second address then cannot sign in (401).
  - The dev admin cannot sign in in production (401).
- **C3 PASS.** CRUD as the first admin: create 201, list 200 (total 1), get 200, patch 200, delete 200, get 404, anonymous 401.
  - `/_console/` returns 200 text/html.
  - Real-browser sign-in as the first admin lands on `/_console/home` ("Get your system ready … 0 of 6 done"), with 0 console errors and 0 responses ≥ 400 after sign-in.
  - Anonymous `get-session` returns 401 before sign-in, as in dev.

## D. UPGRADE 18.5.0 → 18.6.0 WITH REAL DATA (S2, dirs `s2/app185` and `s2/app185b`, ports 41120–41123)
- **D1 PASS.**
  - **Setup on 18.5.0.** `create-objectstack@18.5.0 app185 --skip-skills` (9 pins 18.5.0, 60 lock entries all 18.5.0), plus one record-after-insert flow with an approval node routed to `org_membership_level` owner, and `requires` + `approvals`. `os validate` exit 0.
  - **Data written on 18.5.0 over HTTP** (`os dev` :41120, file DB plus the telemetry sibling):
    - Dev admin sign-in 200.
    - `POST /auth/admin/create-user` 200 (`upg.user@example.com`), and that user signs in 200.
    - `POST /data/app185_note` 201, which opened a pending `sys_approval_request`.
    - `PUT /api/settings/branding {workspace_name:"Smoke v18.5"}` 200 (tenant).
  - **Upgrade.**
    - Pins bumped to 18.6.0, `pnpm install` exit 0, no peer warning, 60 lock entries all 18.6.0.
    - `os --version` is cli/18.6.0, `os validate` exit 0, `os build` exit 0.
    - `os migrate meta --from 18` exit 0 (no step 18 → 18) and `--from 17` exit 0.
    - The first `os migrate plan` exit 0: 8 tables to create and 50 safe `create_index idx_<table>_created_at_id` (driver-sql 479d1e4), 0 destructive.
  - **Migrate steps 18.6.0 names.**
    - `upgrading.mdx` at 958ee035 has no v18.6.0 row (F1a). Its Per-release table stops at v18.5.0. The only data-step lines are "from 18.2.0 or earlier: audit-key-material" and "from 18.4.0 or earlier: audit-side-copies".
    - The 18.6.0 CHANGELOGs add no new data step and no new `os migrate` subcommand.
    - Items that touch migrate:
      - cli 35c9a30 (BREAKING): `os migrate audit-* --apply` takes an audit seal lock and needs `--sealer-stopped` on SQLite/Turso when an object declares `lifecycle.seal`. Not applicable here.
      - cli 895783a: `os migrate` boots a stack that declares queues or assignment rules. Not applicable here.
      - driver-sql 23c42c4: `normalize_boolean_storage`. Not exercised (O-D6).
  - **Subcommands run before the 18.6.0 boot.** Every `os migrate --help` subcommand ran read-only or as a dry run (27 subcommands; the same set as 18.5.0 plus apply, plan and meta).
    - Exit 0: account-issuer, activity-changed-fields, audit-key-material, audit-mail-bodies, audit-metadata-bodies, audit-side-copies, blank-multi-values, blank-single-values, comment-parent-pair, comment-reactions, duplicates, files-to-references, multi-value-columns, option-codes, organization-ownership, packageless-overlays, recorded-by, resume, security-catalog-overlays, stored-expressions, stored-references, summary-nulls, text-scalars, unmapped-columns (`--object`), value-shapes.
    - Two correct refusals for this app: `recompute-home-amounts` exit 1 (no home amount declared) and `record-currency-codes` exit 2 (oclif requires `--code/--field/--object`).
  - **Boot 1 on 18.6.0, same file DB** (health 18.6.0):
    - DATABASE_ERROR 0 and ERROR 0 at ready and after the first `GET /meta/_drafts`. WARN is 1 at ready: the approvals "no public base URL" notice, which 18.5.0 also prints. The count rises to 2 only through the helper's own wrong-password probe.
    - Admin sign-in 200.
    - The created user signs in 200 with the original password, and a wrong password gives 401.
    - The note reads back with its title and body.
    - Branding reads "Smoke v18.5" (tenant), and the approval is still pending.
    - `sys_audit_log` as admin returns 200.
    - The boot printed no `[schema-drift]` line and built the 50 indexes silently.
  - **Apply and plan sequence.**
    - `os migrate apply --yes` exit 0: 8 tables created, 0 changes.
    - The second plan reads "Physical schema is in sync with metadata — nothing to migrate". There is no destructive item, unlike 18.5.0's `actor_id` index drop.
    - `apply --allow-destructive --yes` exit 0 (nothing to apply), and the third plan is in sync.
  - **Boot 2:** 0 DATABASE_ERROR, 0 ERROR. Admin, user, note, branding and the pending approval are all intact. The carried-over request was also approved through `POST /approvals/requests/…/approve` (200).
  - **Side-copy fixture.** A legacy `payload_json` was injected into the telemetry sibling's `sys_audit_log` copy.
    - Bare `os migrate audit-side-copies` printed "Nothing to remove" (O-D1).
    - With `NODE_ENV=development` it found "2 scanned, 1 to rewrite". `--apply --yes` removed it ("1 rewritten"), and a rerun removed nothing.
- **D2 PASS.** The same upgrade on an untouched default scaffold (`app185b`, 18.5.0 → 18.6.0, :41122/:41123).
  - Before the upgrade: create-user 200, that user signs in 200, note 201, branding "Smoke v18.5 B" 200.
  - After: pnpm install exit 0 (only the usual 6 deprecated-subdependency WARNs, no peer warning), 60 lock entries all 18.6.0, `os validate` and `os build` exit 0, `meta --from 18` and `--from 17` exit 0.
  - First plan: 8 tables and 45 safe `create_index`, 0 destructive.
  - Same subcommand set, same two correct refusals.
  - 18.6.0 boot: health 18.6.0, 0 DATABASE_ERROR, 0 ERROR, 0 WARN.
  - Admin 200, `_drafts` 200, the user with the original password 200, note and branding intact.
  - Then plan, `apply --yes` (8 tables), second plan in sync, `apply --allow-destructive` (nothing), third plan in sync (also with `NODE_ENV=development`).
  - Boot 2: 0 DATABASE_ERROR, 0 ERROR, 0 WARN.

## E. POSTGRESQL (16.15 local cluster, port 41119; `pgapp` = a fresh `create-objectstack@18.6.0` scaffold, dev port 41102)
- **E1 PASS.** Before `pg` is installed, `os dev -p 41102 -d postgres://…/smoke186` exits 1 with "The database client package `pg` is not installed, so no connection was attempted. It is an OPTIONAL install of @objectstack/driver-sql … `npm install pg`".
  - It is preceded by knex's raw "Cannot find module 'pg'" and a require stack (unchanged since 18.4.0; observation only).
- **E2 PASS.** After `pnpm add pg` (8.23.1): "Driver: SqlDriver(pg)", ready in 14 s, 42 plugins (43 on SQLite). 0 WARN/ERROR at ready.
  - Sign-in 200. The docs' CRUD gives 201/200 (total 1)/200/200/200 and then 404.
  - `/_console/` returns 200 text/html.
  - Real-browser sign-in lands on `/_console/home`, and a record created through the Console UI gives `POST /data/pgapp_note` 201 and a record panel (`?recordId=p639OppH9UtB8b7n`).
  - 0 console errors and 0 responses ≥ 400 after sign-in.
  - Studio loop on pg (package "Smoke PG", object Ticket):
    - `POST /packages` 201.
    - `PUT /meta/object/smoke_pg_ticket?mode=draft&package=com.default.smoke-pg&surface=studio` 200.
    - `POST /packages/com.default.smoke-pg/publish-drafts` 200.
    - Reload shows "No drafts pending publish".
    - `sys_metadata` holds `object|smoke_pg_ticket|com.default.smoke-pg|active`.
  - A restart on the same database: health up in 14 s, sign-in 200, the published object lists 200 and the note survives. Boot WARN/ERROR = 1: a `[protocol]` WARN (see O-E1).
- **E3 PASS. Re-judge of fix card #33901: the fix holds.**
  - **DATABASE_ERROR count.** On a fresh pg DB (`smoke186`) the count is 0 at ready, 0 after sign-in, and 0 after the first `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts` (200). It stays 0 after a Console home load and a Console UI create, and 0 after Studio publish.
    - It is also 0 after a restart over the same DB, and 0 on a second fresh DB (`smoke186b`) with the same trigger.
  - **Index form.** `pg_indexes` shows the partial runtime form on both DBs: `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active ON sys_metadata USING btree (type, name, COALESCE(package_id,''), COALESCE(bundle_member,'')) WHERE (state = 'active')`.
    - `pg_constraint` has 0 rows for that name, so it is no longer constraint-held.
  - **#26630's own indexes** still hold: `uniq_sys_setting_organization_id_namespace_key_scope_user_id` over `(organization_id, namespace, key, scope, COALESCE(user_id,''))`, and `uniq_sys_notification_preference_a22d7d27`.
  - **Duplicate-active inserts from #33900, in rolled-back transactions.**
    - T1, a second ACTIVE copy of the published `smoke_pg_ticket` row: `ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active"`, key `(object, smoke_pg_ticket, com.default.smoke-pg, )`.
    - T2, two ACTIVE package-less rows `('object','probe_dup')`: the first insert is `INSERT 0 1` and the second is refused with the same error.
    - Controls that must pass do: T3, ACTIVE plus a draft twin, is admitted; T4, `bundle_member` NULL against `'m1'`, is admitted. 0 rows are left over.
  - **Upgrade of an existing DB (beyond the #33900 clause).**
    - 18.5.0 on pg (`smoke185`, a `create-objectstack@18.5.0` scaffold) still reproduces the defect: 1 DATABASE_ERROR after `_drafts`, and the index is `UNIQUE (type, name, package_id, bundle_member)` held by a constraint (`contype u`).
    - The same app and the same DB, with pins bumped to 18.6.0, booted with 0 DATABASE_ERROR and 0 WARN/ERROR/`[metadata-protocol]` lines. The index was converted in place to the partial form, with 0 constraint rows.
  - Postgres's own log has one ERROR on first boot: `relation "sys_migration" does not exist` (see O-E2).

## F. RE-JUDGE AND PROBES
- **F1a FAIL** (release notes / docs; the release itself is unaffected).
  - **The two documents.**
    - `content/docs/upgrading.mdx` at 958ee035 has no `v18.6.0` row. Its Per-release table starts at `v18.5.0` (line 468).
    - `content/docs/releases/v18/18-6.mdx` does not exist at 958ee035. The directory holds 18-0 … 18-5, `index.mdx` and `meta.json`.
  - **Main.** At `55020c331b` (2026-11-18T09:11Z, about 3 h 20 min after the publish) both are still absent. No open issue or PR for the 18.6.0 page turned up (title and body searches).
  - **18.5.0 comparison.** 18.5.0's row and page landed 48 min before its publish (#33823, card #33798).
  - **Tag and index.** `releases/index.mdx` already says "current series: 18.6.0, released 2026-11-18", so the index names a page that does not exist.
- **F1b FAIL, same root cause as F1a. Re-judge of fix card #33903: its CHANGELOG-coverage leg holds; the page-reachability leg fails only because the page is absent.**
  - **Count.** `git log b914e724..958ee035 | grep -c '!:'` gives 64, same with `--no-merges` and `--first-parent`, all 64 conventional `type(scope)!:` subjects (the 18.5.0 smoke counted 63).
  - **Reachability.** From `upgrading.mdx` → the 18.6 release page, 0 of 64 are reachable. There is no row and no page, at the tag or on main. `upgrading.mdx` mentions 18.6.0 once, only as a container image tag (line 55). Nothing else on the page names an 18.6.0 step.
  - **CHANGELOG coverage** (what #33903 fixed): 64 of 64 `!` commits have an `18.6.0` CHANGELOG line, matched by the commit's short sha as the entry prefix in the 127 CHANGELOG files at 958ee035.
    - Published = git: the spec, runtime and cli `CHANGELOG.md` in `node_modules` are byte-identical to those at 958ee035.
  - **Pending changesets at the tag.**
    - `.changeset/` at 958ee035 holds README, `config.json` and exactly 1 pending changeset, `35018-studio-landing-c.md`. Its commit is `0e46840fca` (2026-11-18T03:50Z), whose code is in the tagged code.
    - It is a `patch` of `@object-ui/app-shell`, "Clause-②: no", not a `!` change. Its text is in no CHANGELOG (grep 0 hits).
    - At 18.5.0 there were 11 pending changesets, two of them breaking. 18.6.0 has 1, non-breaking.
    - The #33903 fix landed in #34042.
  - **Disposition.** Do not double-count: the missing page is one defect (F1a), recorded in two cells.
- **F2 PASS.** On a fresh 18.6.0 scaffold (`probe186`, 9 pins exactly 18.6.0): `npx os doctor` exit 0, "✅ Environment is healthy and ready for development!".
  - 0 ⚠/✗ lines, "Platform protocol: Declared engines.protocol covers the installed platform".
  - `npx os --version` prints `@objectstack/cli/18.6.0 linux-x64 node-v22.23.5`.
- **F3 PASS** (headline `!` change `743308b90c`, #34980, "an action body that cannot compile in its (input, ctx) wrapper is refused at validate, build and publish").
  - Scaffold `probe186` with an action `probe186_bad_body` (`type: 'script'`, js body `const ctx = 1; return { ok: true };`):
    - `os validate` exit 1 with "action-body-does-not-compile … SyntaxError: Identifier 'ctx' has already been declared, line 1 … at actions[0].body.source".
    - `os build` exit 1 with the same rule.
  - After removing the redeclaration, `os validate` exit 0 ("Validation passed").
  - Not exercised: the publish door, and the runtime sentence naming the action.
- **F4 PASS** (documented optimistic concurrency, `api/wire-format.mdx`, the surface of open #35142, 18.6.0 on SQLite, `probe186`).
  - Sequential: a stale `If-Match` after a plain PATCH returns 409 `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` with `currentVersion` and `currentRecord`.
  - Race: two concurrent PATCHes with the same fresh `If-Match`, 6 rounds, give `200 ok | 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE` every round.
  - The queue-claim spelling of #35142 (a conditional write on an unowned record) was not re-driven. The runner could not produce an unowned record without a queue fixture: `POST {owner_id: null}` still stamps the creator as owner, and two concurrent `PATCH {owner_id: self}` both returned 200. This cell does not confirm or refute #35142.

## OFF-CLAUSE PROBES (rule 8)
- **Time:** about 6 minutes, after the clauses had verdicts.
- **Covered:**
  - The pg first-boot and post-trigger path, on a second DB and across a restart.
  - A pg DB created on 18.5.0 and booted on 18.6.0.
  - `os start` in production with no `OS_AUTH_SECRET` or `OS_SECRET_KEY`: the process boots and keeps generated secrets on disk (`.objectstack/auth-secret`, `~/.objectstack/dev-crypto-key`) after a "⚠ Production mode, and this server keeps these on its own disk" advisory. That is intended behaviour, and it was killed by the 40 s timeout.
  - Unknown-user and wrong-password sign-ins, which answer 401 INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD.
  - Boundary on the sign-up door.
- **Found:** the `next` dist-tag (O-F1).

## OBSERVATIONS (not filed unless noted)
- **O-F1. `next` dist-tag.** `latest` = 18.6.0 and `next` = 18.5.0 on every package checked, so `npx create-objectstack@next` scaffolds 18.5.0 (checked: create-objectstack, cli, spec, runtime, console and plugin-auth).
  - The 18.5.0 smoke saw `latest = next = 18.5.0`.
  - `scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs` (#25581) moves only a stale PRE-RELEASE `next`. It "leaves a tag on a STABLE version alone". Once 18.5.0 moved `next` onto a stable version, the 18.6.0 sweep leaves it, so `next` now lags `latest`. This is the #25581 defect re-created through the stable-version carve-out.
  - Not release-blocking; drafted as a card below.
- **O-F2.** `content/docs/releases/v18/index.mdx` (at 958ee035 and on main) still says "18.4.0 is released, the newest … 18.5.0 is the next release; its notes are written ahead of its cut" and its table lists 18.5.0 as "not yet: written ahead of the cut". 18.5.0 published on 2026-11-15, and `releases/index.mdx` was updated while this page was not.
- **O-E1.** On every restart of a pg or SQLite dev project that holds a Studio-created package, one WARN prints: `[protocol] package 'com.default.smoke-pg' declares no engines.protocol range; rehydrating without a compatibility check (ADR-0087)`. Studio's "New app of your own" writes a package with no `engines.protocol`. Not filed; may be intended.
- **O-E2.** On a fresh pg DB, Postgres logs `ERROR: relation "sys_migration" does not exist` for `select * from "sys_migration" where "id" = $1` at first boot. This is server-side only, with no app log line, and probably a probe of a missing table.
- **O-D1.** Still holds on 18.6.0. On a dev project the bare `os migrate audit-side-copies` reads only the primary DB and prints "Nothing to remove" while the telemetry sibling holds a copy. `NODE_ENV=development` finds and removes it. The docs name this for plan/apply only.
- **O-D2.** Bare `os migrate plan` and `apply` on a dev file DB still plan and create 8 telemetry-routed tables in the primary.
- **O-D3.** The 18.6.0 pre-boot plan lists 45–50 safe `create_index idx_<table>_created_at_id` entries (driver-sql 479d1e4). The dev boot builds them silently, and a second plan reads 0 changes. The note lives only in the driver-sql CHANGELOG, not in cli docs or `upgrading.mdx`.
- **O-D4.** The cli CHANGELOG entry 35c9a30 calls `os migrate audit-side-copies` "new in this release". It shipped in 18.5.0 (cli 4e1d327).
- **O-D5.** The 18.6.0 BREAKING `--sealer-stopped` / audit seal lock appears in the CHANGELOG and only as flag text in `cli.mdx` "Sealed audit rows". The "Run them with the server stopped" paragraph does not mention it.
- **O-D6.** Not exercised: `normalize_boolean_storage`, `--sealer-stopped` and sealed objects.
